description: This file defines the SugarDateTime class, an extension of PHP's DateTime class, providing additional date and time utilities for SugarCRM/SuiteCRM. It includes methods for parsing, formatting, and manipulating date/time objects, as well as handling localization and custom string representations.

classes.name: SugarDateTime
classes.description: An extension of PHP's DateTime class with added functionalities and custom parsing tailored for SugarCRM/SuiteCRM environment.

methods.name: createFromFormat
methods.description: Creates a SugarDateTime object from a specified format, utilizing PHP's native createFromFormat when available, otherwise custom parsing.

methods.name: _createFromFormat
methods.description: Internal implementation of createFromFormat for PHP versions lacking native support, with custom strptime handling.

methods.name: _getStrings
methods.description: Loads language-specific calendar strings for localization of date components.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Fetches properties like formatted date segments and localized strings based on property name.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Handles dynamic method calls for getter methods and timestamp manipulation.

methods.name: get_datetime_by_index_today
methods.description: Deprecated method to get a specific hour of today.

methods.name: get_hour_end_time
methods.description: Deprecated method to get the last second of the current hour.

methods.name: get_day_end_time
methods.description: Deprecated method to get the last second of the current day.

methods.name: get_day_by_index_this_week
methods.description: Returns a new SugarDateTime object representing the start of a specified weekday within the current week.

methods.name: get_day_by_index_this_year
methods.description: Deprecated method to get the last day of a specific month in the current year.

methods.name: get_day_by_index_this_month
methods.description: Returns a new SugarDateTime object representing the start of a specified day in the current month.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns a new SugarDateTime object modified by a string expression, similar to DateTime::modify.

methods.name: parse_utc_date_time
methods.description: Creates a SugarDateTime object from an ISO 8601 string.

methods.name: getHashList
methods.description: Generates a list of time slots for calendar views based on start and end times.

methods.name: get_day_begin
methods.description: Returns a SugarDateTime object set to the beginning of a specified day, month, and year.

methods.name: get_day_end
methods.description: Returns a SugarDateTime object set to the end of a specified day, month, and year.

methods.name: get_year_begin
methods.description: Deprecated method to get the start of a specific year.

methods.name: asDb
methods.description: Outputs the datetime formatted for database storage, optionally in UTC.

methods.name: asDbDate
methods.description: Outputs the date in database format, optionally in UTC.

methods.name: get_date_str
methods.description: Returns a query string fragment representing the date.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the date in RFC 2822 format.

methods.name: _strptime
methods.description: Internal method for custom parsing using regex, deprecated since PHP 5.2 support was dropped.
